notes.title: 2024Q1 Update - User Configurability update
notes.content: 2024Q1 Update: Thanks for user input in community. User input got reflected as additional user configurability feature. Users are able to configure volume of sound (SE and BGM). Also, language preference is preserved in this version. Please enjoy with your preferred volume of sound - or even set zero volume and enjoy the game with your favorite music background.

notes.title: 2023W52 Update
notes.content:
Thanks to quick inputs. Quick fixes for quick inputs.
[Bug fix]
Fixed Japanese script for magic selection menu malfunction on Stage 5 and 7.
[User Experience improvement]
Explicit language mode on title screen. (Localized "New Game", "Continue" and "Help" on Japanese mode).
